in_marathi.name: Dhruvik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruva is the name of a celestial pole star, and vik means direction. The name Dhruvik refers to the one who is steadfast and unwavering, like the North Star.
